title: Ordinary Differential Equations

syllabus.details: Curves in Euclidean Space: Parametrization, tangent vectors, and arc length. Curvature and torsion. The Frenet-Serret frame: Tangent, normal, and binormal vectors. Frenet-Serret formulas
Surfaces in Euclidean Space: Parametrization, tangent planes, and normal vectors. Tangent planes and the first fundamental form. Surface integrals.
The Gauss map and the second fundamental form: Normal curvature, principal curvatures, Gaussian Curvature and mean curvature.
Intrinsic Geometry of Surfaces: Gauss’s Theorema Egregium. Geodesics and the geodesic equation. Examples of surfaces with constant Gaussian curvature: Planes, spheres, surfaces of revolution.
Special Topics: The Gauss-Bonnet theorem. Compact surfaces and the Euler characteristic.

Applications: Applications of Curves and surfaces in physics (e.g., motion of particles, general relativity), computer graphics (e.g., Bézier curves, splines) and in engineering (e.g., structural design, robotics).
